answer.summary: Using the cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation with additive one-cluster correction, the minimum integer sample size to achieve 90% power in a two-sided test (α = 0.05) for comparing treatment rate 0.005 vs control rate 0.010 per child-week with 2500 child-weeks exposure per cluster and between-cluster CV of 0.15 is **1136 clusters per arm** (2272 total clusters). The achieved power at this design is 0.9003; the preceding design (n = 1135) achieves 0.9000 power, which also meets the 90% target.
answer.method: Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation with additive one-cluster correction. The sample size formula is n = (z_α + z_β)² × cv² × (1/μ₁ + 1/μ₀) / (p₁ - p₀)², where μ₁ and μ₀ are the expected event counts per cluster under treatment and control (12.5 and 25, respectively). The continuous solution (1134.802 clusters per arm) is incremented by 1 to apply the additive one-cluster correction (1135.802), then rounded up to the nearest integer (1136). Power verification uses the formula Power = Φ(√[n(p₁ - p₀)² / (cv² × (1/μ₁ + 1/μ₀))] - z_α), where Φ is the standard normal CDF.

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation (CV) approximation
# for comparing rates in cluster-randomized trials
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Study parameters
p1 <- 0.005     # treatment rate per child-week
p0 <- 0.010     # control rate per child-week
E <- 2500       # exposure (child-weeks) per cluster
cv <- 0.15      # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05   # significance level (two-sided)
power_target <- 0.90

# Two-sided critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # for two-sided test
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # power side (one-sided critical value for power)

# Expected counts per cluster and arm
mu1 <- p1 * E   # treatment: expected events per cluster
mu0 <- p0 * E   # control: expected events per cluster

cat("Treatment rate:", p1, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate:", p0, "per child-week\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment):", mu1, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control):", mu0, "\n")
cat("Rate difference (p1 - p0):", p1 - p0, "\n\n")

# Cluster-rate CV approximation formula:
# Under Poisson variation within clusters and log-normal heterogeneity between clusters,
# the variance of the log rate difference is approximately:
# Var(log(p1) - log(p0)) ≈ cv² * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)

# Variance of rate difference on the log scale
var_log_rd <- cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)

cat("Variance of log(rate difference):", var_log_rd, "\n")
cat("SE of log(rate difference):", sqrt(var_log_rd), "\n\n")

# For comparing means/rates with equal sample sizes n per arm,
# the test statistic on log scale has variance multiplied by 2/n
# (because we estimate separate log rates from n clusters per arm)

# Sample size calculation (continuous):
# (z_alpha + z_beta)² × 2 × var_log_rd = (log(p1/p0))² 
# But we work with rate difference on natural scale.
# 
# More directly for cluster-rate CV approximation:
# Sample size n per arm satisfies:
# (z_alpha + z_beta)² × [cv²/mu1 + cv²/mu0] / n = (p1 - p0)² / (p1 × p0)
# 
# Rearranged: n = (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / [(p1-p0)²/(p1×p0)]

numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)
denominator <- (p1 - p0)^2 / (p1 * p0)

n_continuous <- numerator / denominator

cat("Numerator (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/μ1 + 1/μ0):", numerator, "\n")
cat("Denominator (Δp)²/(p1×p0):", denominator, "\n")
cat("Sample size (continuous):", n_continuous, "\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction: n_adj = n + 1
n_adj <- n_continuous + 1
cat("Sample size with one-cluster correction:", n_adj, "\n\n")

# Round up to nearest integer
n_per_arm <- ceiling(n_continuous)
n_per_arm_corrected <- ceiling(n_adj)

cat("Integer clusters per arm (from continuous, no correction):", n_per_arm, "\n")
cat("Integer clusters per arm (with one-cluster correction applied):", n_per_arm_corrected, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at selected design
# For a given n, power ∝ to the ratio:
# (p1 - p0)² × n / (cv² × (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))

power_achieved_continuous <- function(n) {
  test_stat_sq <- (p1 - p0)^2 * n / (cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  # Standard normal approximate power
  z_power <- sqrt(test_stat_sq) - z_alpha
  pnorm(z_power)
}

power_n_continuous <- power_achieved_continuous(n_continuous)
power_n_integer <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm)
power_n_corrected <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm_corrected)
power_preceding <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm_corrected - 1)

cat("Verification of achieved power:\n")
cat("Power at continuous solution n =", round(n_continuous, 3), ":", round(power_n_continuous, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at integer solution n =", n_per_arm, ":", round(power_n_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", n_per_arm_corrected, "(with one-cluster correction):", round(power_n_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at preceding design n =", n_per_arm_corrected - 1, ":", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n\n")

# Report final answer
cat("========================================\n")
cat("FINAL SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Design method: cluster_rate_cv (with additive one-cluster correction)\n")
cat("Clusters per arm (minimum integer):", n_per_arm_corrected, "\n")
cat("Total clusters (both arms):", 2 * n_per_arm_corrected, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at selected design:", round(power_n_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")

# Structure for output
results <- list(
  sample_size = n_per_arm_corrected,
  sample_size_per_arm = n_per_arm_corrected,
  total_clusters = 2 * n_per_arm_corrected,
  continuous_solution = round(n_continuous, 3),
  power_achieved = round(power_n_corrected, 4),
  power_preceding = round(power_preceding, 4),
  target_power = power_target
)

cat("\nJSON output for result:\n")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(
  list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_per_arm_corrected, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_per_arm_corrected, unit = "clusters"),
  list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_n_corrected, 4), unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "power_preceding_design", value = round(power_preceding, 4), unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 3), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation (CV) approximation
# for comparing rates in cluster-randomized trials
# Reference: Hayes & Moulton, or Eldridge & Kerry textbooks
# Additive one-cluster correction applied

# Study parameters
p1 <- 0.005     # treatment rate per child-week
p0 <- 0.010     # control rate per child-week
E <- 2500       # exposure (child-weeks) per cluster
cv <- 0.15      # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05   # significance level (two-sided)
power_target <- 0.90

# Two-sided critical values
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # for two-sided test
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # power side

cat("========== DESIGN PARAMETERS ==========\n")
cat("Treatment rate (p1):", p1, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate (p0):", p0, "per child-week\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (E):", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")
cat("Critical value z_alpha:", round(z_alpha, 4), "\n")
cat("Critical value z_beta:", round(z_beta, 4), "\n\n")

# Expected counts per cluster and arm
mu1 <- p1 * E   # treatment: expected events per cluster
mu0 <- p0 * E   # control: expected events per cluster

cat("========== EXPECTED COUNTS ==========\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment, μ1):", mu1, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control, μ0):", mu0, "\n")
cat("Rate difference (p1 - p0):", p1 - p0, "\n\n")

# Cluster-rate CV approximation:
# For comparing two rates with Poisson distribution within clusters
# and log-normal variation between clusters:
# 
# Sample size per arm: n = (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/μ1 + 1/μ0) / (p1 - p0)²
#
# This formula treats the rate difference on the natural scale with CV inflation

cat("========== SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION ==========\n")

numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)
denominator <- (p1 - p0)^2

cat("Numerator: (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/μ1 + 1/μ0)\n")
cat("  = (", z_alpha, "+", z_beta, ")² × ", cv, "² × (1/", mu1, "+ 1/", mu0, ")\n")
cat("  = ", round(numerator, 6), "\n\n")

cat("Denominator: (p1 - p0)²\n")
cat("  = (", p1, "-", p0, ")²\n")
cat("  = ", round(denominator, 8), "\n\n")

n_continuous <- numerator / denominator

cat("Continuous solution: n = ", numerator, " / ", denominator, "\n")
cat("                    n = ", round(n_continuous, 3), " clusters per arm\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction
n_corrected <- n_continuous + 1
cat("With additive one-cluster correction: n = ", round(n_corrected, 3), "\n\n")

# Round to integer
n_per_arm <- ceiling(n_corrected)

cat("Integer clusters per arm (rounded up):", n_per_arm, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at different sample sizes
power_at_n <- function(n) {
  # For cluster-rate CV approximation:
  # Power ∝ sqrt(n) × (p1 - p0) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  # More precisely:
  z_stat <- sqrt(n) * (p1 - p0) / (cv * sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  z_power_stat <- z_stat - z_alpha
  pnorm(z_power_stat)
}

power_continuous <- power_at_n(n_continuous)
power_corrected <- power_at_n(n_corrected)
power_integer <- power_at_n(n_per_arm)
power_preceding <- power_at_n(n_per_arm - 1)

cat("========== POWER VERIFICATION ==========\n")
cat("Power at n =", round(n_continuous, 3), "(continuous):", round(power_continuous, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", round(n_corrected, 3), "(with correction):", round(power_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", n_per_arm, "(selected integer):", round(power_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", n_per_arm - 1, "(preceding design):", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n\n")

# Check if selected design meets power requirement
meets_power <- power_integer >= power_target

cat("========== FINAL ANSWER ==========\n")
cat("Clusters per arm:", n_per_arm, "\n")
cat("Total clusters (both arms):", 2 * n_per_arm, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Meets target power (", power_target, "):", meets_power, "\n")
cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_per_arm - 1, "):", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n\n")

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result_json <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_per_arm, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_per_arm, unit = "clusters"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_integer, 4), unit = "probability"),
    list(metric = "power_preceding_design", value = round(power_preceding, 4), unit = "probability"),
    list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 3), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
  )
)

library(jsonlite)
result_json_str <- toJSON(result_json, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
cat("Result JSON:", result_json_str, "\n")

# Proper POWER_AGENT_RESULT format
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", result_json_str, "\n", sep="")

# Cluster-rate CV approximation with corrected power verification
# The test statistic should follow standard normal under the null

p1 <- 0.005     
p0 <- 0.010     
E <- 2500       
cv <- 0.15      
alpha <- 0.05   
power_target <- 0.90

z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   

mu1 <- p1 * E   
mu0 <- p0 * E   

cat("Design Parameters:\n")
cat("p1 =", p1, ", p0 =", p0, ", E =", E, ", cv =", cv, "\n")
cat("μ1 =", mu1, ", μ0 =", mu0, "\n")
cat("z_alpha =", z_alpha, ", z_beta =", z_beta, "\n\n")

# Cluster-rate CV formula
numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)
denominator <- (p1 - p0)^2

n_continuous <- numerator / denominator
n_corrected <- n_continuous + 1
n_integer <- ceiling(n_corrected)

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("n_continuous =", round(n_continuous, 3), "\n")
cat("n_with_correction =", round(n_corrected, 3), "\n")
cat("n_integer =", n_integer, "\n\n")

# Power verification using correct formula:
# Under the cluster-rate CV approximation, the standardized test statistic is:
# Z = (p1 - p0) × sqrt(n) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
# 
# Under the null hypothesis (p1 = p0), Z ~ N(0,1)
# Under the alternative, Z has expectation (p1 - p0) × sqrt(n) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
# Power = P(Z > z_alpha | H1)

power_at_n <- function(n) {
  # Standardized effect size
  se_diff <- cv * sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / sqrt(n)
  # Effect: p1 - p0
  effect <- p1 - p0
  # Standardized test statistic under H1
  z_noncentrality <- abs(effect) / se_diff  # abs because we care about magnitude
  # Power: P(|Z| > z_alpha)
  # For two-sided test: power = P(Z > z_alpha) + P(Z < -z_alpha)
  # When effect is in expected direction:
  power <- pnorm(z_noncentrality - z_alpha) + pnorm(-z_noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power
}

# Actually, let me reconsider. For a two-sided test with noncentrality parameter λ:
# Power = P(|Z| > z_alpha under H1)
# where the noncentrality is λ = |effect| / SE

power_at_n_v2 <- function(n) {
  se_diff <- cv * sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / sqrt(n)
  noncentrality <- abs(p1 - p0) / se_diff
  
  # For two-sided test with noncentrality λ
  # Power = Φ(λ - z_alpha) + Φ(-λ - z_alpha)
  # But the second term is negligible when λ is positive
  # Standard approach: Power = Φ(λ - z_alpha)
  
  # Actually for two-sided:
  power_right <- pnorm(noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power_left <- pnorm(-noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power <- power_right + power_left
  power
}

# Let's use a simpler verification:
# At the sample size that solves the equation, by definition we achieve target power
# Check: (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 = [sqrt(n) × |p1-p0| / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1+1/mu0))]^2

verify_power <- function(n) {
  # Right-hand side of the power equation
  rhs_squared <- n * (p1 - p0)^2 / (cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  
  # At power_target, LHS = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2
  lhs_target <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2
  
  cat("For n =", n, ":\n")
  cat("  LHS (at power_target):", lhs_target, "\n")
  cat("  RHS (from n):", rhs_squared, "\n")
  cat("  Ratio RHS/LHS:", rhs_squared / lhs_target, "\n")
  
  # Power equation: Φ(sqrt(RHS) - z_alpha) = power_target
  implied_power <- pnorm(sqrt(rhs_squared) - z_alpha)
  cat("  Implied power:", round(implied_power, 4), "\n\n")
  
  implied_power
}

power_continuous <- verify_power(n_continuous)
power_corrected <- verify_power(n_corrected)
power_integer <- verify_power(n_integer)
power_preceding <- verify_power(n_integer - 1)

cat("========== SUMMARY ==========\n")
cat("Selected design: n =", n_integer, "clusters per arm\n")
cat("Total clusters: ", 2 * n_integer, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")
cat("Meets target:", power_integer >= power_target, "\n")
cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_integer - 1, "):", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n")

# Output JSON
library(jsonlite)
result_json <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_integer, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_integer, unit = "clusters"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_integer, 4), unit = "probability"),
    list(metric = "power_preceding_design", value = round(power_preceding, 4), unit = "probability"),
    list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 3), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
  )
)

result_json_str <- toJSON(result_json, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", result_json_str, "\n", sep="")

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation (CV) approximation
# for comparing rates in cluster-randomized trials
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Study parameters
p1 <- 0.005     # treatment rate per child-week
p0 <- 0.010     # control rate per child-week
E <- 2500       # exposure (child-weeks) per cluster
cv <- 0.15      # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05   # significance level (two-sided)
power_target <- 0.90

# Two-sided critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # for two-sided test
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # power side (one-sided critical value for power)

# Expected counts per cluster and arm
mu1 <- p1 * E   # treatment: expected events per cluster
mu0 <- p0 * E   # control: expected events per cluster

cat("Treatment rate:", p1, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate:", p0, "per child-week\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment):", mu1, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control):", mu0, "\n")
cat("Rate difference (p1 - p0):", p1 - p0, "\n\n")

# Cluster-rate CV approximation formula:
# Under Poisson variation within clusters and log-normal heterogeneity between clusters,
# the variance of the log rate difference is approximately:
# Var(log(p1) - log(p0)) ≈ cv² * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)

# Variance of rate difference on the log scale
var_log_rd <- cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)

cat("Variance of log(rate difference):", var_log_rd, "\n")
cat("SE of log(rate difference):", sqrt(var_log_rd), "\n\n")

# For comparing means/rates with equal sample sizes n per arm,
# the test statistic on log scale has variance multiplied by 2/n
# (because we estimate separate log rates from n clusters per arm)

# Sample size calculation (continuous):
# (z_alpha + z_beta)² × 2 × var_log_rd = (log(p1/p0))² 
# But we work with rate difference on natural scale.
# 
# More directly for cluster-rate CV approximation:
# Sample size n per arm satisfies:
# (z_alpha + z_beta)² × [cv²/mu1 + cv²/mu0] / n = (p1 - p0)² / (p1 × p0)
# 
# Rearranged: n = (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / [(p1-p0)²/(p1×p0)]

numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)
denominator <- (p1 - p0)^2 / (p1 * p0)

n_continuous <- numerator / denominator

cat("Numerator (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/μ1 + 1/μ0):", numerator, "\n")
cat("Denominator (Δp)²/(p1×p0):", denominator, "\n")
cat("Sample size (continuous):", n_continuous, "\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction: n_adj = n + 1
n_adj <- n_continuous + 1
cat("Sample size with one-cluster correction:", n_adj, "\n\n")

# Round up to nearest integer
n_per_arm <- ceiling(n_continuous)
n_per_arm_corrected <- ceiling(n_adj)

cat("Integer clusters per arm (from continuous, no correction):", n_per_arm, "\n")
cat("Integer clusters per arm (with one-cluster correction applied):", n_per_arm_corrected, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at selected design
# For a given n, power ∝ to the ratio:
# (p1 - p0)² × n / (cv² × (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))

power_achieved_continuous <- function(n) {
  test_stat_sq <- (p1 - p0)^2 * n / (cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  # Standard normal approximate power
  z_power <- sqrt(test_stat_sq) - z_alpha
  pnorm(z_power)
}

power_n_continuous <- power_achieved_continuous(n_continuous)
power_n_integer <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm)
power_n_corrected <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm_corrected)
power_preceding <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm_corrected - 1)

cat("Verification of achieved power:\n")
cat("Power at continuous solution n =", round(n_continuous, 3), ":", round(power_n_continuous, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at integer solution n =", n_per_arm, ":", round(power_n_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", n_per_arm_corrected, "(with one-cluster correction):", round(power_n_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at preceding design n =", n_per_arm_corrected - 1, ":", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n\n")

# Report final answer
cat("========================================\n")
cat("FINAL SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Design method: cluster_rate_cv (with additive one-cluster correction)\n")
cat("Clusters per arm (minimum integer):", n_per_arm_corrected, "\n")
cat("Total clusters (both arms):", 2 * n_per_arm_corrected, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at selected design:", round(power_n_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")

# Structure for output
results <- list(
  sample_size = n_per_arm_corrected,
  sample_size_per_arm = n_per_arm_corrected,
  total_clusters = 2 * n_per_arm_corrected,
  continuous_solution = round(n_continuous, 3),
  power_achieved = round(power_n_corrected, 4),
  power_preceding = round(power_preceding, 4),
  target_power = power_target
)

cat("\nJSON output for result:\n")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(
  list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_per_arm_corrected, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_per_arm_corrected, unit = "clusters"),
  list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_n_corrected, 4), unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "power_preceding_design", value = round(power_preceding, 4), unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 3), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

# The test statistic should follow standard normal under the null

p1 <- 0.005     
p0 <- 0.010     
E <- 2500       
cv <- 0.15      
alpha <- 0.05   
power_target <- 0.90

z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   

mu1 <- p1 * E   
mu0 <- p0 * E   

cat("Design Parameters:\n")
cat("p1 =", p1, ", p0 =", p0, ", E =", E, ", cv =", cv, "\n")
cat("μ1 =", mu1, ", μ0 =", mu0, "\n")
cat("z_alpha =", z_alpha, ", z_beta =", z_beta, "\n\n")

# Cluster-rate CV formula
numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)
denominator <- (p1 - p0)^2

n_continuous <- numerator / denominator
n_corrected <- n_continuous + 1
n_integer <- ceiling(n_corrected)

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("n_continuous =", round(n_continuous, 3), "\n")
cat("n_with_correction =", round(n_corrected, 3), "\n")
cat("n_integer =", n_integer, "\n\n")

# Power verification using correct formula:
# Under the cluster-rate CV approximation, the standardized test statistic is:
# Z = (p1 - p0) × sqrt(n) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
# 
# Under the null hypothesis (p1 = p0), Z ~ N(0,1)
# Under the alternative, Z has expectation (p1 - p0) × sqrt(n) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
# Power = P(Z > z_alpha | H1)

power_at_n <- function(n) {
  # Standardized effect size
  se_diff <- cv * sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / sqrt(n)
  # Effect: p1 - p0
  effect <- p1 - p0
  # Standardized test statistic under H1
  z_noncentrality <- abs(effect) / se_diff  # abs because we care about magnitude
  # Power: P(|Z| > z_alpha)
  # For two-sided test: power = P(Z > z_alpha) + P(Z < -z_alpha)
  # When effect is in expected direction:
  power <- pnorm(z_noncentrality - z_alpha) + pnorm(-z_noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power
}

# Actually, let me reconsider. For a two-sided test with noncentrality parameter λ:
# Power = P(|Z| > z_alpha under H1)
# where the noncentrality is λ = |effect| / SE

power_at_n_v2 <- function(n) {
  se_diff <- cv * sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / sqrt(n)
  noncentrality <- abs(p1 - p0) / se_diff
  
  # For two-sided test with noncentrality λ
  # Power = Φ(λ - z_alpha) + Φ(-λ - z_alpha)
  # But the second term is negligible when λ is positive
  # Standard approach: Power = Φ(λ - z_alpha)
  
  # Actually for two-sided:
  power_right <- pnorm(noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power_left <- pnorm(-noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power <- power_right + power_left
  power
}

# Let's use a simpler verification:
# At the sample size that solves the equation, by definition we achieve target power
# Check: (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 = [sqrt(n) × |p1-p0| / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1+1/mu0))]^2

verify_power <- function(n) {
  # Right-hand side of the power equation
  rhs_squared <- n * (p1 - p0)^2 / (cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  
  # At power_target, LHS = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2
  lhs_target <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2
  
  cat("For n =", n, ":\n")
  cat("  LHS (at power_target):", lhs_target, "\n")
  cat("  RHS (from n):", rhs_squared, "\n")
  cat("  Ratio RHS/LHS:", rhs_squared / lhs_target, "\n")
  
  # Power equation: Φ(sqrt(RHS) - z_alpha) = power_target
  implied_power <- pnorm(sqrt(rhs_squared) - z_alpha)
  cat("  Implied power:", round(implied_power, 4), "\n\n")
  
  implied_power
}

power_continuous <- verify_power(n_continuous)
power_corrected <- verify_power(n_corrected)
power_integer <- verify_power(n_integer)
power_preceding <- verify_power(n_integer - 1)

cat("========== SUMMARY ==========\n")
cat("Selected design: n =", n_integer, "clusters per arm\n")
cat("Total clusters: ", 2 * n_integer, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")
cat("Meets target:", power_integer >= power_target, "\n")
cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_integer - 1, "):", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n")

# Output JSON
library(jsonlite)
result_json <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_integer, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_integer, unit = "clusters"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_integer, 4), unit = "probability"),
    list(metric = "power_preceding_design", value = round(power_preceding, 4), unit = "probability"),
    list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 3), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
  )
)

result_json_str <- toJSON(result_json, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", result_json_str, "\n", sep="")

# Evidence e1; success=false

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation (CV) approximation
# for comparing rates in cluster-randomized trials
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Study parameters
p1 <- 0.005     # treatment rate per child-week
p0 <- 0.010     # control rate per child-week
E <- 2500       # exposure (child-weeks) per cluster
cv <- 0.15      # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05   # significance level (two-sided)
power_target <- 0.90

# Two-sided critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # for two-sided test
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # power side (one-sided critical value for power)

# Expected counts per cluster and arm
mu1 <- p1 * E   # treatment: expected events per cluster
mu0 <- p0 * E   # control: expected events per cluster

cat("Treatment rate:", p1, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate:", p0, "per child-week\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (treatment):", mu1, "\n")
cat("Expected events per cluster (control):", mu0, "\n")
cat("Rate difference (p1 - p0):", p1 - p0, "\n\n")

# Cluster-rate CV approximation formula:
# Under Poisson variation within clusters and log-normal heterogeneity between clusters,
# the variance of the log rate difference is approximately:
# Var(log(p1) - log(p0)) ≈ cv² * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)

# Variance of rate difference on the log scale
var_log_rd <- cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)

cat("Variance of log(rate difference):", var_log_rd, "\n")
cat("SE of log(rate difference):", sqrt(var_log_rd), "\n\n")

# For comparing means/rates with equal sample sizes n per arm,
# the test statistic on log scale has variance multiplied by 2/n
# (because we estimate separate log rates from n clusters per arm)

# Sample size calculation (continuous):
# (z_alpha + z_beta)² × 2 × var_log_rd = (log(p1/p0))² 
# But we work with rate difference on natural scale.
# 
# More directly for cluster-rate CV approximation:
# Sample size n per arm satisfies:
# (z_alpha + z_beta)² × [cv²/mu1 + cv²/mu0] / n = (p1 - p0)² / (p1 × p0)
# 
# Rearranged: n = (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / [(p1-p0)²/(p1×p0)]

numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0)
denominator <- (p1 - p0)^2 / (p1 * p0)

n_continuous <- numerator / denominator

cat("Numerator (z_alpha + z_beta)² × cv² × (1/μ1 + 1/μ0):", numerator, "\n")
cat("Denominator (Δp)²/(p1×p0):", denominator, "\n")
cat("Sample size (continuous):", n_continuous, "\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction: n_adj = n + 1
n_adj <- n_continuous + 1
cat("Sample size with one-cluster correction:", n_adj, "\n\n")

# Round up to nearest integer
n_per_arm <- ceiling(n_continuous)
n_per_arm_corrected <- ceiling(n_adj)

cat("Integer clusters per arm (from continuous, no correction):", n_per_arm, "\n")
cat("Integer clusters per arm (with one-cluster correction applied):", n_per_arm_corrected, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at selected design
# For a given n, power ∝ to the ratio:
# (p1 - p0)² × n / (cv² × (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))

power_achieved_continuous <- function(n) {
  test_stat_sq <- (p1 - p0)^2 * n / (cv^2 * (1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
  # Standard normal approximate power
  z_power <- sqrt(test_stat_sq) - z_alpha
  pnorm(z_power)
}

power_n_continuous <- power_achieved_continuous(n_continuous)
power_n_integer <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm)
power_n_corrected <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm_corrected)
power_preceding <- power_achieved_continuous(n_per_arm_corrected - 1)

cat("Verification of achieved power:\n")
cat("Power at continuous solution n =", round(n_continuous, 3), ":", round(power_n_continuous, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at integer solution n =", n_per_arm, ":", round(power_n_integer, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", n_per_arm_corrected, "(with one-cluster correction):", round(power_n_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at preceding design n =", n_per_arm_corrected - 1, ":", round(power_preceding, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n\n")

# Report final answer
cat("========================================\n")
cat("FINAL SAMPLE SIZE CALCULATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Design method: cluster_rate_cv (with additive one-cluster correction)\n")
cat("Clusters per arm (minimum integer):", n_per_arm_corrected, "\n")
cat("Total clusters (both arms):", 2 * n_per_arm_corrected, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at selected design:", round(power_n_corrected, 4), "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")

# Structure for output
results <- list(
  sample_size = n_per_arm_corrected,
  sample_size_per_arm = n_per_arm_corrected,
  total_clusters = 2 * n_per_arm_corrected,
  continuous_solution = round(n_continuous, 3),
  power_achieved = round(power_n_corrected, 4),
  power_preceding = round(power_preceding, 4),
  target_power = power_target
)

cat("\nJSON output for result:\n")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(
  list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_per_arm_corrected, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_per_arm_corrected, unit = "clusters"),
  list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_n_corrected, 4), unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "power_preceding_design", value = round(power_preceding, 4), unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_continuous, 3), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

# Power verification using correct formula:
# Under the cluster-rate CV approximation, the standardized test statistic is:
# Z = (p1 - p0) × sqrt(n) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
# 
# Under the null hypothesis (p1 = p0), Z ~ N(0,1)
# Under the alternative, Z has expectation (p1 - p0) × sqrt(n) / (cv × sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0))
# Power = P(Z > z_alpha | H1)

power_at_n <- function(n) {
  # Standardized effect size
  se_diff <- cv * sqrt(1/mu1 + 1/mu0) / sqrt(n)
  # Effect: p1 - p0
  effect <- p1 - p0
  # Standardized test statistic under H1
  z_noncentrality <- abs(effect) / se_diff  # abs because we care about magnitude
  # Power: P(|Z| > z_alpha)
  # For two-sided test: power = P(Z > z_alpha) + P(Z < -z_alpha)
  # When effect is in expected direction:
  power <- pnorm(z_noncentrality - z_alpha) + pnorm(-z_noncentrality - z_alpha)
  power
}

# Actually, let me reconsider. For a two-sided test with noncentrality parameter λ:
# Power = P(|Z| > z_alpha under H1)
# where the noncentrality is λ = |effect| / SE

  # But the second term is negligible when λ is positive
  # Standard approach: Power = Φ(λ - z_alpha)

  power_right <- pnorm(noncentrality - z_alpha)

  power
